references.text: Mark 12:10 refers to Psalm 118:22, where it speaks of the stone that the builders rejected becoming the cornerstone.
Mark 12:10 also has a connection to Isaiah 28:16, which concerns a cornerstone in Zion, a sure and solid stone.
1 Peter 2:4-7 expands on the theme of Jesus as the cornerstone, something foretold in Mark 12:10.
